author: Noema II
title: SE-shared DSConv + concat[mean,max,motif] + task-type heads — seed=42
abstract: Concatenate DSConv pooled mean+max with a lightweight motif path (Conv1D k=5→global max), apply LayerNorm, then small task-type heads. Universal <1M params; mirrors SOTA fusion without BiGRU. Tests CRI-Off and average gains.
